title: Alchemy Flask
description: Potion-brewing is a pedestrian art. Any hedge-witch with a cauldron can boil nether wart into a serviceable tincture. By weaving <positive>Essentia Vitae</positive> into the brewing process, you <magic>transcend</magic> the crude limitations of conventional alchemy.

Forged upon the <named>Ara Vitae</named>, the <keyword>Alchemy Flask</keyword> holds eight doses of whatever elixir you fill it with. Once drained to its dregs, rinse it with water to prepare a fresh vessel. Flasks may also be transmuted into projectile forms:
